sonnet.problem: The statement says the LORD says that at this time next year Sarah will have a son. Verse 10 says the LORD will return at this time next year, and that Sarah will have a son. The statement ties the return time to the birth, which the verse doesn't say. Verse 14 gives the same pairing as 'in about a year'.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The last story card tells no part of the passage. Sarah's denial and the LORD's reply were already covered on cards 18 and 19. The card is only a joke about denying something, plus the 'story isn't over' line. The joke does not ride on a card that tells passage content.
sonnet.rule: Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.
